title: Back with Elgar, then touring with Plantation Days to Europe
summary: Reel 2 begins: Howard returns to Elgar's band, then goes on the road with the Plantation Days show, his first trip to Europe.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: So what did you do when you came back to Chicago?
What did I do? Wait a minute. Oh, I went back to work with Elgar. And that's the same, that's the same...
Is he still playing in the same place?

Yes. He closed there and that's the band, that's when I went out on the road with Plantation Day and I come looking for this man. And that's the first time I went to Europe. Plantation Day, he went to Europe.
